title: Magic Item Plans Lvl2+
contents: subtitle | Learn the plans for Common Magic Items
text | When you gain Replicate Magic Item, you may learn plans for Common magic items, excluding potions, scrolls, and cursed items.
text | • Any Common magic item (non-potion, non-scroll, non-cursed)
text | • Each chosen item counts as a separate plan.
bullet | Wand of the War Mage +1 (attunement)

title: Magic Item Plans Lvl6+
contents: subtitle | Learn the plans for Uncommon Magic Items
text | At level 6, you may learn plans for Uncommon magic items.
bullet | Cloak of the Manta Ray
bullet | Any Uncommon Armor, Wand, or Weapon (non-cursed)

title: Magic Item Plans Lvl10+
contents: subtitle | Learn the plans for Uncommon Rings and Wondrous Items
text | At level 10, you now learn how to replicate Uncommon Rings and Wondrous Items.
text | Each item selected counts as a separate plan.

title: Magic Item Plans Lvl14+
contents: subtitle | Learn the plans for Rare Magic Items
text | At level 14 youn learn how to replicate Rare magic items.
text | You may have up to 3 Rare replicated items at a time.
